[SWS_CRYPT_20909]
{DRAFT}
Signalization of revoked certificate by applica-
tion or functional cluster
⌈
Dedicated applications are allowed to inform the
X.509
Provider
of a misuse or of the invalidity of certificates. The
X.509 Provider
stores
this information by revoking internally the specified certificate. This can either be done
in the internal structure where certificates are stored or by updating the stored revoca-
tion list. When the
X.509 Provider
generates a
CRL
, it uses its internal information.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02306)
